hero.lede: What the Waifu Devs are making together. Everything lives on GitHub, so star it, break it, and send a pull request.
cta.title: Got an idea?
cta.body: Every project here is open source. Open an issue, pick one up, or show up with a project of your own.
fuwa.tagline: Chat servers you can own. Hosted by us, or by you.
fuwa.description.intro: {name} (ふわ, as in {fuwafuwa}: fluffy) is a chat app in the spirit of Discord that you can run yourself, or use right now at {link}.
fuwa.description.files: Every community server keeps its members, channels and messages in {databaseFile} (Turso, so it still opens as plain SQLite): a whole community is one file you can back up, move or hand to a friend. The server and the desktop app are written in Rust, direct messages and their calls are end-to-end encrypted, and one app holds as many servers as you like: ones on fuwa.chat, your friend's, and the one humming in your closet.
fuwa.highlight.file.title: One file per server
fuwa.highlight.file.body: Members, channels, messages and events live in that server's own Turso database file.
fuwa.highlight.selfHost.title: Self-host it
fuwa.highlight.selfHost.body: One Docker image or one Rust binary on your own box, with accounts of its own and every message kept at home.
fuwa.highlight.hosted.title: Or let us host it
fuwa.highlight.hosted.body: fuwa.chat is up and running, for when you just want to chat.
fuwa.highlight.manyServers.title: One app, many servers
fuwa.highlight.manyServers.body: Hosted and self-hosted servers sit together in one sidebar, in your browser or the desktop app.
fuwa.roadmap.server: Rust server on Turso, a database file per community server, with its own accounts
fuwa.roadmap.webApp: Web app served by every fuwa server, with every setting in the app: roles, bans, automod, welcome screens, audit log and instance admin
fuwa.roadmap.scaleOut: One binary that splits into gateways, a directory and shards to scale out
fuwa.roadmap.signIn: Sign in with waifu.dev or a standalone account, invites, roles, server rules and applications to join
fuwa.roadmap.launch: fuwa.chat goes live, with release 0.1.0, a Docker image and a self-hosting guide
fuwa.roadmap.backups: fuwa.chat split across machines, with every database copied to backup storage
fuwa.roadmap.e2ee: End-to-end encrypted direct messages (MLS): the server only ever sees ciphertext
fuwa.roadmap.voice: Voice channels and direct message calls, end-to-end encrypted in DMs, with your ping on screen
fuwa.roadmap.agents: Agents, bots and apps that chat, and talk in voice channels
fuwa.roadmap.sso: Single sign-on (SSO and SAML) for a whole instance or a single server, off until you turn it on
fuwa.roadmap.proxy: No leaked IP addresses: pictures and link previews come through your fuwa server, never straight to your device
fuwa.roadmap.reorder: Drag channels and categories into order
fuwa.roadmap.desktop: Native desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux, written in Rust with GPUI: chat, DMs, settings, themes and shortcuts (installers arrive with the next release)
fuwa.roadmap.video: Cameras and screen sharing in calls, each one able to pop out into its own window
fuwa.roadmap.themes: Custom themes, background pictures, moving GPU effects and shaders you write yourself
fuwa.roadmap.shortcuts: Keyboard shortcuts you can change, the same on the web and the desktop
fuwa.roadmap.recording: Record calls on your device, and voice channels on the server with a track per person
fuwa.roadmap.reports: Anonymous bug, speed and usage reports, with an off switch in every app
fuwa.roadmap.desktopSettings: The last server settings pages in the desktop app: automod, welcome screen and agents
fuwa.roadmap.screenAudio: Sound with a shared screen, from a tab or the whole system
fuwa.roadmap.regions: Servers in more regions (US, Europe, Asia), with each server's data kept in the region its owner picks
fuwa.roadmap.desktopCalls: Calls in the desktop app, with each camera in a window of its own
fuwa.roadmap.desktopShaders: Your own shaders in the desktop app
fuwa.roadmap.recordingLimits: Limits on how much a server records, and old recordings cleared away by themselves
fuwa.roadmap.relay: A relay on fuwa.chat so calls connect on strict networks
fuwa.roadmap.tray: The desktop app in your system tray
fuwa.demo.waifu2: wait, every server is its own sqlite file?
fuwa.network.title: One client. Any server. A database each.
fuwa.roadmap.title: Where fuwa is at.
site.tagline: The community's home on the web. You're standing in it.
site.description.intro: The site you're on right now. Sign in with GitHub, make a profile at {path}, and design a theme that repaints every page, for you and for anyone who visits your profile.
site.description.stack: It's written end to end with {effect}: an API server and a {tanstackStart} web app on Postgres, hosted on Railway.
site.highlight.signIn.title: GitHub sign-in
site.highlight.signIn.body: One click, and your login and avatar follow you in.
site.highlight.profiles.title: Profiles
site.highlight.profiles.body: Bio, status, skills, links and a banner at /u/you.
site.highlight.themes.title: Themes
site.highlight.themes.body: Paint a theme in the live editor and the whole site wears it.
site.highlight.news.title: News
site.highlight.news.body: Share links and posts at /news, vote them up and talk them over.
